newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen rising on foreign fund hopes.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen rising on foreign fund hopes.

text.p: Hopes for an inflow of foreign funds this week are expected to bolster Seoul stocks on Monday, brokers said.
They said investors were pinning their hopes on an expansion of the foreign stock ownership ceiling to 23 percent, effective from May 2, from 20 percent.
"Blue chips will be highlighted. And low-priced, large-cap shares are also expected to benefit from the limit expansion," said Cha Hee-gun of Sunkyong Securities.
The composite stock index closed on Saturaday at 699.76, up 8.28 points.
